anti_overlap: fd-draw-loom-warp-tension-conservation covers whether an enhance/obsolesce co-lift is REPRESENTABLE in the compile-time `feeds_into` heald (is there a legal arm, or must the &'static table be re-threaded; is the pairing done in the card-chain rather than as a runtime scalar over an unedited table; is there a shed-width bound) using compile-time-selection reasoning alone -- this fused agent covers ONLY the cases where answering the representability question strictly requires the runtime budget-enforcement judgment about the SAME object (a legal pair that the plenum cannot pay under load; a shed-width bound that no regulator enforces at runtime), and drops any finding the loom lens could reach without the plenum's head-budget accounting.

fd-organ-wind-regulation-conserved-plenum covers whether a routing is PAID FOR from an enforced plenum -- named wind-source, robbing-guard ceiling, loud failure on over-draw, subtraction routed through `reduce_attributed` -- using runtime budget-enforcement reasoning alone -- this fused agent covers ONLY the cases where the runtime budget-enforcement is load-bearing on the compile-time representability of the SAME object (a budgeted `reduce_attributed` routing whose lowered coupling is not the paired counterpart of any legal `feeds_into` arm -- budgeted injection; a robbing-guard clamp guarding an unbounded card-chain), and drops any finding the organ lens could report without reference to whether the co-lift is representable in the compile-time table.

fd-agent-based-modeling-tier-locality covers which population tier a mechanism should reside at and whether its ablation gating is complete at that tier, using tier-correctness reasoning alone -- this fused agent takes no position on which tier is correct and covers only whether a conservation object proven representable-AND-budgeted at one tier is a DIFFERENT, unproven conservation object at another tier (no agent-tier heald arm AND/OR two independent plenums that jointly inflate), which requires the two-locus conservation frame the tier lens does not carry.

fd-forcing-curve-historiography covers whether the print->broadcast->algorithmic media-era transition is historiographically sound as a slow forcing curve (diffusion timing, era boundaries) -- this fused agent takes no position on media-timing soundness and covers only whether the forcing-curve HOST fails at BOTH conservation loci at once (cannot re-thread the heald AND cannot regulate a plenum, for the same reason -- it is a magnitude ramp with neither a selection-table nor a regulator).

fd-calibration-reproof-economics covers the referee-hour / confirmatory-run cost of certifying a mechanism under jackpot-cal-v1 discipline -- this fused agent covers only the cases where the re-proof COST turns on the two-locus split (a compile-time heald re-thread is byte-provable-until-picked while a runtime regulator change is never behavior-neutral, so the cost is a sum across two differently-priced loci that a single-class estimate mis-prices), and drops any cost finding that does not turn on the compile-time-vs-runtime locus distinction.
decision_lens: Reports a finding ONLY when it strictly requires BOTH parent frames -- where a loom-only reviewer (fd-draw-loom-warp-tension-conservation) would stop at 'no `feeds_into` arm represents this co-lift / the sketch varies a runtime weight over an unedited &'static table' and a organ-only reviewer (fd-organ-wind-regulation-conserved-plenum) would stop at 'no enforced ceiling / no robbing-guard / this draw is unbudgeted' -- and the finding exists precisely in the gap neither closes alone: a mechanism whose conservation is CERTIFIED at one locus and UNCERTIFIED (or silently violated) at the other, so the sketch reads as conserving when it half-conserves. Prioritizes: (1) loom-representable-but-organ-unpayable co-lifts -- a legal `feeds_into` pairing (or a legal re-thread the sketch proposes) whose realized runtime draw under stacked forcing-curves + shocks exceeds any enforced budget and robs another coupling flat, so 'every enhance paired with an obsolesce' is satisfied in the card-chain yet total head still inflates or detunes at runtime; (2) organ-payable-but-loom-unrepresentable routings -- a bounded, clamping, robbing-guarded 'lowering' of a coupling (e.g. routed through `reduce_attributed`) that is NOT the paired counterpart of any legal `feeds_into` arm, so the plenum honestly pays for a subtraction the heald never authorized to pair with the enhance -- injection with a budget bolted on, redistribution only in the ledger; (3) the specific tier/locus-crossing case where a mechanism proven conserving at the COUNTRY heald+plenum is a different, unproven conservation object at the AGENT tier (AGENT_EFFECT_SCALE path, effects.rs:134) -- a co-lift the country card-chain weaves and the country plenum pays may have no agent-tier heald arm AND no agent-tier budget, so 'conserved' is true of one plenum and undefined of the other. Deprioritizes / drops to base lenses: any finding a loom-only lens could reach without the runtime-budget-enforcement question (belongs to fd-draw-loom-warp-tension-conservation); any finding a organ-only lens could reach without the compile-time-representability question (belongs to fd-organ-wind-regulation-conserved-plenum); any tier-placement finding a modeling lens reaches without either conservation locus (belongs to fd-agent-based-modeling-tier-locality); any historiographic media-timing finding (belongs to fd-forcing-curve-historiography); any referee-hour estimate that does not turn on the two-locus split (belongs to fd-calibration-reproof-economics). This lens is empty of value unless the compile-time-representability claim and the runtime-budget-enforcement claim are wired to the SAME mechanism object and disagree about whether it conserves.
focus: Whether a candidate conservation-aware media-ecology mechanism for shadow-work has its enhance/obsolesce pairing proven at BOTH of the two loci where 'conservation' actually lives in this codebase -- the compile-time selection table (`PressureType::feeds_into()`, the &'static heald that fixes WHICH co-lifts are even representable) AND the runtime head-budget (an enforced plenum ceiling that clamps/refuses when realized draw exceeds the declared allotment, routed through the one extant named-source subtraction `reduce_attributed`) -- or whether it is proven at ONE locus and silently unproven at the other. The single question this lens exists to answer: for each mechanism sketch, is there a co-lift that is loom-representable (a legal `feeds_into` pairing the heald can weave) yet organ-unpayable (blows the plenum / robs another coupling flat at runtime with no enforced clamp), OR a routing that is organ-payable (bounded, budgeted, clamps loudly) yet loom-unrepresentable (enforces a ceiling on a pairing the &'static table never wove -- an injected co-lift wearing a paid-routing costume), such that the sketch's conservation claim is a bookkeeping artifact at whichever locus it skipped rather than a mechanism? The tension is NOT to be resolved: the lens INVESTIGATES exactly where in shadow-work's purely-additive pressure lattice (f-013: 14 additive pillars, no add() ever paired with a subtraction) that compile-time-vs-runtime conservation-locus split can hide a mechanism that is half-proven and reads as whole.
name: fd-fused-compiletime-representability-runtime-budget-locus
persona: Apply the FUSED perspective of a draw-loom/jacquard weaver (for whom conservation IS the fixed heald: a figure is a SELECTION over a pre-tensioned warp, and the only question that matters is whether a co-lift is even REPRESENTABLE in the compile-time card-chain before any pick is thrown -- an enhance is worthless if the harness has no heddle to pair it with an obsolesce) AND a pipe-organ voicer/wind-regulator (for whom conservation IS the enforced plenum: every rank that speaks must be PAID FOR out of one regulated reservoir, over-draw ROBS soft ranks flat as a silent detune, and a routing is worthless if the wind cannot supply it under load), held simultaneously by one reviewer who refuses to hand off between them. This reviewer treats every conservation claim as terminating in TWO questions at once and files nothing until both are answered of the SAME object: the weaver's question -- is this enhance/obsolesce pair a legal arm of the &'static `feeds_into` heald, or is the sketch 'modulating' a pairing that must first be re-threaded (a costly loom-down compile-time edit, not a runtime scalar)? -- and the voicer's question -- is this routing paid for out of a named, enforced head-budget that clamps or refuses on over-draw, or does it silently exceed its allotment under stacked shocks and rob another coupling into a band-breaking detune? The reviewer knows the two failure modes are the same conservation-hole viewed from two sides: a co-lift that is loom-legal but organ-bankrupt (the heald can weave it, the plenum cannot pay it) and a routing that is organ-solvent but loom-illegal (the plenum pays it, but the heald never wove the pair -- so the 'lower' half is injection dressed as redistribution) are, at any single mechanism sketch, the TWO WAYS a conservation claim can be true at one locus and false at the other -- and only a reviewer holding both the compile-time-representability frame and the runtime-budget-enforcement frame can see that a sketch proven at one locus is not proven, rather than filing a loom-only 'no heald slot' finding or an organ-only 'no robbing-guard' finding that each miss the other half of the same hole.
review_areas: The `feeds_into` heald arm as representable-AND-unpayable: for any sketch that proposes an enhance/obsolesce pair, test both loci at once -- (loom) is the pair a legal arm of `PressureType::feeds_into()` (crates/shadowbench-core/src/emergence/pressures/types.rs:116, the &'static 13-arm match), or does expressing it require re-threading that compile-time table (a loom-down edit, not a runtime scalar)? AND (organ) even if the arm is legal or the re-thread is proposed, does the realized runtime draw of the ENHANCE half stay inside an enforced head-budget under stacked forcing-curves + shocks, or does it rob the OBSOLESCE half's coupling (and neighbors) into a silent detune that drifts the sim out of the jackpot-cal-v1 band? The fused finding is a co-lift the heald can legally weave whose plenum cannot pay it under load -- neither parent reaches this: the loom stops at 'the arm exists' (declares it conserved), the organ stops at 'the draw is unbudgeted' (but does not know the pair is loom-legal, so cannot tell 'unbudgeted-but-representable' from 'unbudgeted-and-unrepresentable', which have opposite fixes).

`reduce_attributed` as payable-but-unrepresentable: the one extant named-source subtraction hook (crates/shadowbench-core/src/emergence/pressures/store/external.rs:32,52, implemented-but-dead) is the natural home for the 'lower' half of any pair and it is organ-legible (a named wind-source routing, budgetable, clampable). The fused test: a sketch that routes its obsolesce half through `reduce_attributed` with a proper robbing-guard is organ-PAYABLE -- but is the coupling it lowers the paired counterpart of any legal `feeds_into` arm the enhance half raises? If not, the plenum honestly pays for a subtraction the heald never wove into a pair, so the mechanism is redistribution in the runtime ledger and injection in the compile-time table -- a bounded, budgeted, clamping INJECTION. The organ lens sees a clean paid routing and passes it; the loom lens sees no representable pair; only the fusion sees that a correct budget on an unrepresentable pair is precisely how injection passes a conservation review.

The forcing-curve host at the two-locus intersection: fd-forcing-curve-historiography and the base lenses each flag that a forcing curve is additive-magnitude-only (config/types.rs:33-107, global capacity-mediated ramps -- it cannot edit `feeds_into` and cannot enforce a ceiling). The fused sharpening: hosting the print->broadcast->algorithmic media-era transition on a forcing curve is a DOUBLE locus failure -- it can neither re-thread the heald (loom: cannot change WHICH co-lifts are representable, so an era that should widen selection-bandwidth is unexpressible) NOR regulate a plenum (organ: cannot clamp draw, so an era that inflates magnitude robs unguarded). A reviewer holding one frame flags one half; the fusion establishes that the forcing-curve host fails at BOTH loci for the SAME reason (it is a magnitude ramp with neither a selection-table nor a regulator), which is a strictly stronger disqualification than either single-locus 'wrong host' finding and changes the costing (a real media-era mechanism needs BOTH a compile-time table edit AND a runtime regulator, not one forcing-curve value).

Cross-tier conservation-object identity (country heald+plenum vs agent heald+plenum): fd-agent-based-modeling-tier-locality asks which tier a mechanism should live at; this lens asks the different question of whether a mechanism proven CONSERVING at the country tier is the SAME conservation object at the agent tier or an unproven second one. Test both loci across the tier boundary: (loom) does the agent tier even have a `feeds_into`-analog heald, or are agent effects a separate application path (AGENT_EFFECT_SCALE = 0.05, emergence/tick/effects.rs:134) with no co-lift-pairing table at all -- so an enhance/obsolesce pair legal at the country tier has NO representable pairing at the agent tier? AND (organ) do the two tiers share one regulated plenum (one enforced ceiling spanning ~80 agents + 221 countries) or two independent plenums that each locally conserve while jointly inflating total head? The fused finding is a mechanism whose 'conserved' claim is true of the country plenum, undefined at the agent heald, and silently double-counted across two unlinked plenums -- visible only to a reviewer who checks representability AND budget-enforcement AT EACH tier.

The bounded-lift-set / shed-width bound as the plenum's robbing threshold: the loom's shed-width bound (max simultaneous raises before the band breaks) and the organ's robbing-guard (max simultaneous draw before ranks detune flat) are the SAME ceiling named from two disciplines -- but a sketch can declare one and skip the other. The fused test: does the mechanism state a maximum-simultaneous-raise bound (loom, a card-chain property) that is ACTUALLY WIRED to an enforced runtime head-budget with a loud failure (organ, a regulator property), or does it declare a compile-time bound with no runtime enforcement (a shed-width on paper that the plenum never checks) or a runtime clamp with no compile-time bound (a regulator guarding an unbounded card-chain)? A conservation mechanism needs the two to be the same number enforced at both loci; a sketch that names one is proven at one locus only.

Behavior-neutral re-proof split as a two-locus obligation: the target's re-proof discipline (byte-referee for behavior-neutral edits vs full modulation battery for the rest) maps cleanly onto ONE locus each -- a compile-time `feeds_into` heald re-thread is byte-provably behavior-neutral UNTIL a pick is thrown (loom: a draft edit changes nothing until a pick applies it), while a runtime budget/regulator change is NEVER behavior-neutral (organ: re-regulating the reservoir re-voices every affected rank on wind). The fused finding: a sketch that edits BOTH loci (re-threads the heald AND changes the plenum enforcement) has a re-proof cost that is neither purely byte-referee nor purely full-battery -- the compile-time half is byte-provable-when-unpicked but the runtime half demands re-regulation of every affected coupling, so mis-costing the mechanism as a single re-proof class (all-byte or all-battery) under-certifies whichever locus was assigned the cheaper class. Only a reviewer tracking both loci sees that the re-proof cost is a SUM across two differently-priced loci, not a single class.

severity_examples.condition: Under stacked forcing-curves + a compound shock the realized runtime draw of the enhance half exceeds any declared allotment and robs the obsolesce coupling (and its neighbors) flat, drifting the sim out of the jackpot-cal-v1 band as a SILENT detune -- because the sketch never wired the compile-time pairing to an ENFORCED runtime ceiling that clamps or refuses on over-draw (no robbing-guard). The co-lift is loom-representable and organ-unpayable: 'conserved' is true of the card-chain and false of the plenum, and the failure surfaces not as an error but as an out-of-band re-cal weeks later -- the single most expensive failure given re-certification cost. intersection_justification REQUIRED: the finding is the identity between 'the pair is a legal `feeds_into` arm' (loom -- which is why it passed representability review) and 'the pair has no enforced runtime budget so it robs under load' (organ) -- a loom-only reviewer declares it conserved, a organ-only reviewer flags an unbudgeted draw but cannot tell it is a representable pair (so cannot distinguish 'add the guard' from 'this pair should not exist'); the fix (wire the existing legal pair to a regulator) is visible only when both frames name the same co-lift.
severity_examples.intersection_justification: loom-representable co-lift (compile-time locus certified) AND organ-unpayable draw (runtime locus violated) are the same conservation hole from two sides; neither lens alone distinguishes 'representable-but-unguarded' (add a regulator) from 'unrepresentable-and-unguarded' (do not build it), which have opposite fixes.
severity_examples.scenario: A mechanism sketch proposes 'when print-era media is high, enhance NarrativeControl and obsolesce InstitutionalTrust' and satisfies the loom by pointing to (or proposing a re-thread of) a legal `feeds_into` arm pairing the two, declaring 'every enhancement paired with something left down' -- conservation certified at the compile-time locus

severity_examples.condition: The coupling it lowers is NOT the paired counterpart of any legal `feeds_into` arm that the enhance half raises -- there is no compile-time heald slot pairing this enhance with this obsolesce, so the subtraction is authorized only by the runtime budget, never by the selection table. The mechanism is therefore a bounded, budgeted, clamping INJECTION: redistribution in the runtime ledger, injection in the compile-time table (the enhance mints head the heald never paired against a real obsolesce; the `reduce_attributed` call lowers an UNRELATED coupling that merely balances the books numerically). The organ lens sees a clean paid routing and passes it; only the fusion sees that a correct budget on a loom-unrepresentable pair is exactly how injection passes a conservation review -- 'modulate, don't inject' is satisfied in arithmetic and violated in structure. intersection_justification REQUIRED below.
severity_examples.intersection_justification: organ-payable routing (runtime locus certified via reduce_attributed + robbing-guard) AND loom-unrepresentable pairing (no `feeds_into` arm pairs this enhance with this obsolesce) are the same hole; a organ-only reviewer certifies the paid routing and cannot see the pair is not a legal co-lift, a loom-only reviewer sees no arm but cannot see the budget makes it LOOK conserved -- only the fusion names 'budgeted injection' as the failure mode.
severity_examples.scenario: A sketch routes its 'lower' half through `reduce_attributed` (store/external.rs:32,52) with a proper enforced head-budget and a loud robbing-guard clamp, and the organ frame certifies it: named wind-source, budgeted, clamps on over-draw -- conservation certified at the runtime locus

severity_examples.condition: The agent tier has no `feeds_into`-analog heald (agent effects are a separate scaled application path, not a co-lift-pairing table), so the enhance/obsolesce pair legal at the country tier has NO representable pairing at the agent tier (loom: unrepresentable at this tier); AND the two tiers draw from independent budgets (or the agent path has no budget at all), so each tier can locally satisfy 'conserved' while the combined system inflates total head across tiers (organ: two unlinked plenums double-count). 'Conserved' is thereby true of the country plenum, undefined at the agent heald, and silently inflated across the tier boundary. Rises to P0 if the agent-tier path applies the enhance with no obsolesce counterpart at all (pure agent-tier injection). intersection_justification REQUIRED below.
severity_examples.intersection_justification: no agent-tier heald arm (loom: the pair is unrepresentable at the agent tier) AND two independent plenums with no shared ceiling (organ: joint inflation despite per-tier conservation) are the same cross-tier hole; fd-agent-based-modeling-tier-locality asks only WHICH tier should host the mechanism and takes no position on whether conservation is representable-and-budgeted at each -- this finding requires checking both conservation loci at both tiers, which neither the tier lens nor either single-locus lens does alone.
severity_examples.scenario: A mechanism proven conserving at the country tier (legal `feeds_into` pair + enforced country-tier head-budget) is proposed to ALSO act at the agent tier via the AGENT_EFFECT_SCALE path (emergence/tick/effects.rs:134), on the reasoning that media effects are agent-legible (ideology/personality)

severity_examples.condition: The compile-time shed-width bound and the runtime robbing-guard are the SAME ceiling named from two disciplines, and the sketch names one without wiring it to the other: a shed-width bound on paper that the plenum never checks at runtime (the card-chain says 'at most N co-lifts' but no regulator enforces it under load), OR a runtime clamp guarding an unbounded card-chain (the regulator refuses over-draw but the compile-time table permits unboundedly many pairs to be legal, so the clamp fires constantly and the mechanism is effectively off). Either way the ceiling is enforced at one locus and unenforced at the other, so the conservation bound is real at compile time and fictional at runtime (or vice versa). intersection_justification REQUIRED below.
severity_examples.intersection_justification: shed-width bound (loom, a compile-time card-chain property) and robbing-guard ceiling (organ, a runtime regulator property) are the same number that must be enforced at both loci; a loom-only reviewer accepts the declared shed-width, a organ-only reviewer accepts the declared clamp, and only the fusion checks that the two are the SAME enforced bound rather than one-declared-one-absent.
severity_examples.scenario: A sketch declares a maximum-simultaneous-raise bound (a shed-width / bounded-lift-set, satisfying the loom's 'the band breaks past N raises') as its conservation guarantee, or alternatively declares a runtime head-budget clamp (satisfying the organ's robbing-guard) -- but declares only ONE of the two

severity_examples.condition: The two loci have DIFFERENT re-proof classes: the compile-time heald re-thread is byte-provably behavior-neutral UNTIL a pick is thrown (a draft edit changes nothing until applied -- byte-referee suffices for the un-picked state), but the runtime regulator change is NEVER behavior-neutral (re-regulating the reservoir re-voices every affected coupling on wind -- demands the full battery). Costing the mechanism as one class under-certifies whichever locus got the cheaper class: an all-byte estimate misses that the regulator change needs the battery; an all-battery estimate over-charges the byte-provable heald half and may hide that the heald edit's behavior-neutrality was never actually byte-proven. The true cost is a SUM across two differently-priced loci. Downgraded to P2 because it is a costing/certification-planning defect, not a runtime conservation violation. intersection_justification REQUIRED below.
severity_examples.intersection_justification: compile-time heald re-thread (loom: byte-provably behavior-neutral until a pick) and runtime regulator change (organ: never behavior-neutral, needs re-regulation of every rank) are two differently-priced re-proof loci in the same mechanism; fd-calibration-reproof-economics prices re-proof effort but not the two-locus split, and neither single-locus lens sees that the mechanism's cost is a sum across a byte-provable locus and a full-battery locus.
severity_examples.scenario: A mechanism edits BOTH loci -- it re-threads the `feeds_into` heald (a new compile-time co-lift arm) AND changes the runtime plenum enforcement (a new budget/clamp) -- and its re-proof cost is estimated as a single certification class (either all byte-referee 'it's behavior-neutral' or all full-modulation-battery)

success_hints: EVERY finding carries an explicit intersection_justification naming (a) the specific compile-time-representability claim from the loom frame (is this enhance/obsolesce pair a legal `feeds_into` arm, or does it need a heald re-thread) and (b) the specific runtime-budget-enforcement fact from the organ frame (is this draw paid from a named source and clamped on over-draw), and states why the finding collapses to nothing if either half is removed. A finding a single-locus lens could reach alone is out of scope and must be dropped, not downgraded.

The review identifies the shared mechanism object -- a specific proposed enhance/obsolesce pair, a specific `reduce_attributed` routing, a specific forcing-curve or agent-tier host -- that the representability-claim and the budget-enforcement-claim are BOTH wired to, and treats the finding as the identity between the two conservation defects at that object (representable-but-unpayable, or payable-but-unrepresentable), not as two co-located but separable problems.

The review's signature move is naming which of the two conservation loci a sketch SKIPPED: for every sketch that claims to conserve, it states explicitly 'proven at the compile-time heald (a legal `feeds_into` pair / a proposed re-thread) but unproven at the runtime plenum (no enforced budget)' OR 'proven at the runtime plenum (budgeted `reduce_attributed` routing + robbing-guard) but unproven at the compile-time heald (no legal pairing -- budgeted injection)', and treats a claim proven at only one locus as NOT proven.

The review explicitly distinguishes its findings from what fd-draw-loom-warp-tension-conservation (compile-time representability alone), fd-organ-wind-regulation-conserved-plenum (runtime budget-enforcement alone), fd-agent-based-modeling-tier-locality (tier placement), and fd-forcing-curve-historiography (media-era timing) report on their own, and cites the specific base findings it fuses (e.g. the loom's `feeds_into` heald-site finding + the organ's robbing-guard/reduce_attributed findings) rather than restating either base finding.

For the cross-tier and shed-width/robbing-guard cases, the review checks BOTH loci at BOTH tiers (or at both compile-time and runtime) and names the specific place where a conservation object proven at one locus/tier is undefined or double-counted at the other -- the fused lens's core value is catching the mechanism that is half-proven and reads as whole, which requires holding the compile-time-table frame and the runtime-regulator frame on the same object at once.

The review NEVER resolves the tension between the two loci into a single 'correct' locus -- it does not declare compile-time representability or runtime budget-enforcement the true home of conservation. It INVESTIGATES where in shadow-work's additive lattice a mechanism's conservation claim splits across the two loci, and reports the split; prescribing one locus as canonical is out of scope.
task_context: Design inquiry, lens-fusion round of a goal-seeking flux-melange loop (Run A, bead shadow-work-v0w7, target docs/research/2026-07-18-media-ecology-conservation-fuse-target.md): this agent is the fused intersection-detector of two base lenses -- fd-draw-loom-warp-tension-conservation (conservation as the compile-time selection table: which enhance/obsolesce co-lifts are REPRESENTABLE in the &'static `feeds_into` heald before any pick is thrown) and fd-organ-wind-regulation-conserved-plenum (conservation as the runtime head-budget: whether a routing is PAID FOR from an enforced plenum that clamps/refuses on over-draw and routes subtractions through the one extant named-source hook `reduce_attributed`). The tension it exists to INVESTIGATE (not resolve): the loom locates conservation at compile-time representability and its blind spot is the runtime head-BUDGET accounting (it checks a raise is paired, not that total draw stays within an enforced reservoir); the organ locates conservation at runtime budget-enforcement and its blind spot is compile-time representability (it checks a routing is paid for and bounded, not that the co-lift is even expressible in the compile-time table) -- so a candidate conservation-aware media-ecology mechanism can be proven conserving at ONE locus while silently violating conservation at the OTHER, and 'does this mechanism conserve head?' cannot be answered without asking BOTH 'is the pair representable in the heald?' AND 'is the draw payable by the plenum under load?' of the same object. The codebase reality this operates against: f-013 -- all 14 pillars are purely additive (`collect_pressure_deltas` -> `add_attributed`), no `add()` ever paired with a subtraction, so there is NO conservation machinery of any kind; f-016 -- `PressureType::feeds_into()` returns `&'static [PressureType]`, a compile-time table (the heald); `reduce_attributed` (store/external.rs:32,52) is the one implemented-but-dead named-source subtraction hook (the plenum's only extant routing-out). The HARD CONSTRAINT: report a finding ONLY if it strictly requires BOTH parent perspectives; every finding must include an intersection_justification stating the compile-time-representability claim, the runtime-budget-enforcement fact, and why removing either half collapses the finding. Overall generative goal for this review round: maximize verified novelty x risk surface until dry, concentrated at the two-locus intersection -- answering: for shadow-work's proposed conservation-aware media-ecology mechanisms, where does the conservation claim split across compile-time representability and runtime budget-enforcement such that a half-proven mechanism reads as whole?
